from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    longest = []
    maxlen = 0
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if g[r][c] == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and g[pr][pc] != bg:
                    continue
                cells=[]
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and g[rr][cc] != bg:
                    cells.append((rr,cc))
                    rr += dr; cc += dc
                n=len(cells)
                if n > maxlen:
                    maxlen=n; longest=[(cells, dr, dc)]
                elif n == maxlen:
                    longest.append((cells, dr, dc))
    for cells, dr, dc in longest:
        if len(cells) < 2:
            continue
        # Extend a same-color run at either end of a longest diagonal sequence.
        color=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        run=1
        while run < len(cells) and g[cells[run][0]][cells[run][1]] == color:
            run += 1
        if run >= 2:
            r,c=cells[0]
            r-=dr; c-=dc
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and g[r][c] == bg:
                g[r][c]=color
                r-=dr; c-=dc
        color=g[cells[-1][0]][cells[-1][1]]
        run=1
        i=len(cells)-2
        while i >= 0 and g[cells[i][0]][cells[i][1]] == color:
            run+=1; i-=1
        if run >= 2:
            r,c=cells[-1]
            r+=dr; c+=dc
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and g[r][c] == bg:
                g[r][c]=color
                r+=dr; c+=dc
    return g
'''
path=base/'task-dc7edc6e.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
